statement: The client is a 41-year-old investor with a 12-year investment horizon, a growth objective, a balanced risk profile (Risk Class 3), and a high capacity to bear losses. The proposed portfolio consists of iShares Core MSCI World UCITS ETF (SRI 4), Montpensier Arbevel Best Business Models SRI RC (SRI 4), and iShares € Govt Bond 15-30yr UCITS ETF EUR Dist (SRI 4). The portfolio is not suitable because its weighted SRI of 4.0 exceeds the maximum limit of 3.5 for this profile. To achieve suitability, the portfolio composition must be adjusted to include lower-risk instruments with lower SRI ratings to bring the weighted SRI within the permissible threshold. The client does not have a near-term liquidity need within the next two years. Draft for advisor review and signature.
